description: v6.1 W1: realistic mixed sessions, the way people work. Five repositories, one continuing conversation each, launched on Opus: a quick question, a smaller task, a question about the code, a harder task. Plain Opus at its default effort (what most people run), plain Sonnet high, and AutoMode v6c launched on Opus with nothing pinned. Questions are graded by whether the answer names the file and symbol, each fact checked in the source at that step's base; tasks by their hidden tests. Fixed before any row. The W1 smoke (v6-w1-mixed-smoke) ran the marked session on code before the snapshot fix; this run repeats it on the fixed code.

marked.ask: Where does this repository tokenize fenced code blocks? Name the file and the method.
Which renderer method turns a list token into HTML? Name the file and the method.

jsyaml.ask: In which file and function does this repository read a YAML alias?
Which file and function write a node when YAML is dumped?

boltons.ask: Which file defines OrderedMultiDict, and which built-in class does it extend?
Which file defines IndexedSet, and which abstract base class does it extend?

jinja.ask: Which file defines the Namespace class used by the namespace() template global?
Which file defines the Undefined class?

nodesemver.ask: Which file implements the diff function?
Which file implements intersection of two ranges?
